description:
About the Scholarship

EPOG trains economists to understand and shape the emerging bifurcation of the global economy, with tracks in macroeconomics, financial systems and development led from Université Paris Cité and Sorbonne partners. The 2027 intake round closes on 27 January 2027 at 13:00 Paris time.

OpportunityEPOG – Erasmus Mundus Master in Economic Policies for the Global Bifurcation
HostEPOG Consortium
LocationParis (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline27 January 2027 (13:00 Paris time)
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EPOG trains economists to understand and shape the emerging bifurcation of the global economy, with tracks in macroeconomics, financial systems and development led from Université Paris Cité and Sorbonne partners. The 2027 intake round closes on 27 January 2027 at 13:00 Paris time.

Programme Highlights

  • Heterodox-plus-mainstream economics curriculum with strong global-south links
  • Late-January scholarship deadline (27 January 2027, 13:00 Paris time)
  • Multi-country mobility with specialisation tracks
  • Graduates join central banks, international organisations, NGOs and academia

Who Should Apply

Economics and social-science graduates with solid quantitative training; motivation letters should engage with the programme's global-transformation agenda.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the EPOG admission portal before 27 January 2027 (13:00 Paris time) and check track-specific requirements. Key deadline information: 27 January 2027 (13:00 Paris time).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EPOG Consortium

The EPOG consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Economic Policies for the Global Bifurcation, coordinated from Paris with European and global partner universities.

Official website: https://www.epog.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 27 January 2027 (13:00 Paris time) - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
